Big Graph 2 · Communities and language similarity

Communities are detected from interaction edges, without using language. Each node’s color compares its average TF-IDF cosine similarity with other characters in its community against its similarity to characters outside the community. The distribution chart compares all eligible within-community and between-community character pairs.

Interaction communities · color = within minus between similarity

Node placement groups Louvain communities for readability. Positions do not encode language similarity. Hover for within/outside similarity and degree.

Pairwise TF-IDF cosine similarity

Character names and common English words are excluded from TF-IDF. Name-component filtering can also remove ordinary words such as “black” or “wood.” This is an exploratory comparison; scene/topic overlap can make voices look similar.
